title: "Queue up to 100 emails"

---

```http
POST /v1/emails/batch
```

Each item carries its own `idempotency_key` and gets its own result. One rejection does not undo the others. The HTTP status is 200 whenever the batch itself was readable.

## Authentication

Send a server-side API key: `Authorization: Bearer $NJIWA_MAIL_API_KEY`. See [Authentication](/docs/authentication).

Required scope: `emails:send` or `emails:send_raw (per item)`.

## Request body

Content type: `application/json`. Required.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `messages` | array of object | yes | at least 1 items. at most 100 items. |
| `messages[].from` | string | yes | An approved sender identity for the key's project and environment. |
| `messages[].to` | string | yes | One recipient (bare address). Together with cc and bcc at most 10 addresses. |
| `messages[].template` | string | no | A built-in template (otp, password-reset, account-notice) or one published for the project. Omit it for a raw send. |
| `messages[].template_version` | integer | no | Omit it to use the newest published version. minimum 1. |
| `messages[].locale` | string | no | A language tag such as en or sw (Kiswahili); your own templates can use others such as fr. Missing content falls back to English. default `"en"`. pattern `^[A-Za-z]{2,3}([-_][A-Za-z0-9]{2,8})?$`. |
| `messages[].variables` | object | no | otp: name?, code (4-12 letters or digits), expires_in_minutes (1-60). password-reset: name?, reset_url (https, origin approved for the environment), expires_in_minutes (1-1440). account-notice: name?, title (&lt;=100, single line), message (&lt;=1000). HTML is escaped. |
| `messages[].ttl_seconds` | integer | no | Submission will not start after this. Auth templates default 300 (max 900); notices default 3600 (max 86400). minimum 30. |
| `messages[].metadata` | object | no | no other fields. |
| `messages[].metadata.request_id` | string | no | pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}$`. |
| `messages[].subject` | string | no | Raw send only (scope emails:send_raw). |
| `messages[].html` | string | no | Raw send only. |
| `messages[].text` | string | no | Raw send only. |
| `messages[].reply_to` | string | no | &nbsp; |
| `messages[].cc` | array of string | no | &nbsp; |
| `messages[].bcc` | array of string | no | &nbsp; |
| `messages[].priority` | "high" \| "normal" | no | otp and password-reset default to high. |
| `messages[].send_at` | string (date-time) | no | RFC 3339, at most 7 days ahead. |
| `messages[].web_view` | boolean | no | Adds a "view in browser" link at the top of the message, backed by a signed copy of the HTML that expires after 30 days. Not allowed with priority high (one-time codes, password resets). |
| `messages[].attachments` | array of object | no | at most 5 items. |
| `messages[].attachments[].filename` | string | yes | &nbsp; |
| `messages[].attachments[].content_type` | "application/pdf" \| "image/png" \| "image/jpeg" \| "text/plain" | yes | &nbsp; |
| `messages[].attachments[].content` | string (byte) | yes | Standard base64. At most 5 files and 5 MiB in total. |
| `messages[].headers` | map of string to string | no | &nbsp; |
| `messages[].idempotency_key` | string | yes | pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{8,128}$`. |

Example:

```json
{
  "messages": [
    {
      "idempotency_key": "welcome-1001",
      "from": "noreply@notify.example.com",
      "to": "a@example.org",
      "template": "account-notice",
      "variables": {
        "title": "Welcome",
        "message": "Your account is ready."
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

print(response.json())

<Tab value="Go">

```go
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	body := []byte(`{"messages":[{"idempotency_key":"welcome-1001","from":"noreply@notify.example.com","to":"a@example.org","template":"account-notice","variables":{"title":"Welcome","message":"Your account is ready."}}]}`)
	req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", os.Getenv("NJIWA_MAIL_URL")+"/v1/emails/batch", bytes.NewReader(body))
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+os.Getenv("NJIWA_MAIL_API_KEY"))
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	res, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer res.Body.Close()
	out, _ := io.ReadAll(res.Body)
	fmt.Println(res.StatusCode, string(out))
}
```

Keys belong on your server: never put them in a browser, a mobile app, a URL or a log.

## Responses

### 200

One result per message, in order.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `results` | array of object | no | &nbsp; |
| `results[].index` | integer | yes | &nbsp; |
| `results[].id` | string (uuid) | no | &nbsp; |
| `results[].status` | integer | yes | The HTTP status this item would have had on its own (202 accepted). |
| `results[].state` | string | no | &nbsp; |
| `results[].code` | string | no | Error code when status is not 202. |

```json
{
  "results": [
    {
      "index": 0,
      "id": "6f1c2d0e-3b52-4d49-9a43-7d1f0c5e8a11",
      "status": 202,
      "state": "queued"
    }
  ]
}
```

### 401

invalid_api_key. The response carries `WWW-Authenticate`.

Header `WWW-Authenticate`: string

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "invalid_api_key"
  }
}
```

### 422

Error. See `error.code`.

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "invalid_batch"
  }
}
```

## Error codes

Errors share one shape: `error.code` is stable, `error.message` is optional detail. Retry only timeouts, network errors, `429` and `5xx`, with the same idempotency key; fix the request for every other `4xx`.

| Code | HTTP | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `invalid_api_key` | 401 | Missing, wrong, revoked or expired key |
| `ip_not_allowed` | 403 | The caller's address is not on the key's allowlist |
| `invalid_batch` | 422 | A batch with 0 or more than 100 messages |
| `invalid_request` | 422 | Unreadable JSON, unknown field, or a missing required field |

Every code is explained on [Rate limits and errors](/docs/api/rate-limits-and-errors).
